assistant_runs_tokens_chk.name: assistant_runs_tokens_chk
assistant_runs_tokens_chk.value: ("assistant_runs"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "assistant_runs"."input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("assistant_runs"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "assistant_runs"."output_tokens" >= 0)

companies_tax_id_chk.name: companies_tax_id_chk
companies_tax_id_chk.value: "companies"."tax_id" IS NULL OR ("companies"."kind" = 'PF' AND "companies"."tax_id" ~ '^[0-9]{11}$') OR ("companies"."kind" = 'PJ' AND "companies"."tax_id" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$')

crm_activities_actor_chk.name: crm_activities_actor_chk
crm_activities_actor_chk.value: "crm_activities"."actor_type" IN ('USER','NERO','SYSTEM','INTEGRATION') AND ("crm_activities"."actor_type" NOT IN ('USER','NERO') OR "crm_activities"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

crm_activities_command_chk.name: crm_activities_command_chk
crm_activities_command_chk.value: ("crm_activities"."command_namespace" IS NULL AND "crm_activities"."idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "crm_activities"."request_hash" IS NULL) OR ("crm_activities"."command_namespace" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("crm_activities"."command_namespace")) > 0 AND "crm_activities"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("crm_activities"."idempotency_key")) > 0 AND "crm_activities"."request_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_activities"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

crm_contacts_tax_chk.name: crm_contacts_tax_chk
crm_contacts_tax_chk.value: ("crm_contacts"."tax_id" IS NULL AND "crm_contacts"."tax_id_kind" IS NULL) OR ("crm_contacts"."tax_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_contacts"."tax_id_kind" IS NOT NULL AND (("crm_contacts"."tax_id_kind" = 'PF' AND "crm_contacts"."tax_id" ~ '^[0-9]{11}$') OR ("crm_contacts"."tax_id_kind" = 'PJ' AND "crm_contacts"."tax_id" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$')))

crm_entries_event_uq.name: crm_entries_event_uq
crm_entries_event_uq.where: "crm_lead_entries"."source_namespace" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_lead_entries"."source_event_id" IS NOT NULL

crm_meeting_events_actor_chk.name: crm_meeting_events_actor_chk
crm_meeting_events_actor_chk.value: "crm_meeting_events"."actor_type" IN ('USER','NERO','SYSTEM') AND ("crm_meeting_events"."actor_type" = 'SYSTEM' OR "crm_meeting_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

crm_meeting_participants_kind_chk.name: crm_meeting_participants_kind_chk
crm_meeting_participants_kind_chk.value: ("crm_meeting_participants"."kind" = 'CONTACT' AND "crm_meeting_participants"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_meeting_participants"."user_id" IS NULL) OR ("crm_meeting_participants"."kind" = 'USER' AND "crm_meeting_participants"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_meeting_participants"."contact_id" IS NULL) OR ("crm_meeting_participants"."kind" = 'EXTERNAL' AND "crm_meeting_participants"."user_id" IS NULL AND "crm_meeting_participants"."contact_id" IS NULL AND ("crm_meeting_participants"."name" IS NOT NULL OR "crm_meeting_participants"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "crm_meeting_participants"."phone" IS NOT NULL))

crm_meetings_lifecycle_chk.name: crm_meetings_lifecycle_chk
crm_meetings_lifecycle_chk.value: ("crm_meetings"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("crm_meetings"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("crm_meetings"."status" = 'CANCELED') = ("crm_meetings"."canceled_at" IS NOT NULL)

crm_meetings_text_chk.name: crm_meetings_text_chk
crm_meetings_text_chk.value: ("crm_meetings"."description" IS NULL OR length("crm_meetings"."description") <= 10000) AND ("crm_meetings"."notes" IS NULL OR length("crm_meetings"."notes") <= 10000) AND ("crm_meetings"."outcome_notes" IS NULL OR length("crm_meetings"."outcome_notes") <= 10000) AND ("crm_meetings"."next_steps" IS NULL OR length("crm_meetings"."next_steps") <= 10000)

crm_opportunities_reason_chk.name: crm_opportunities_reason_chk
crm_opportunities_reason_chk.value: "crm_opportunities"."commercial_status" IN ('LOST','DISQUALIFIED') OR ("crm_opportunities"."reason_code" IS NULL AND "crm_opportunities"."reason_text" IS NULL)

crm_proposal_events_actor_chk.name: crm_proposal_events_actor_chk
crm_proposal_events_actor_chk.value: "crm_proposal_events"."actor_type" IN ('USER','NERO','SYSTEM') AND ("crm_proposal_events"."actor_type" = 'SYSTEM' OR "crm_proposal_events"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

crm_proposal_items_totals_chk.name: crm_proposal_items_totals_chk
crm_proposal_items_totals_chk.value: "crm_proposal_items"."position" > 0 AND "crm_proposal_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "crm_proposal_items"."unit_price" >= 0 AND "crm_proposal_items"."gross_amount" = round("crm_proposal_items"."quantity" * "crm_proposal_items"."unit_price", 2) AND "crm_proposal_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 AND "crm_proposal_items"."discount_amount" <= "crm_proposal_items"."gross_amount" AND "crm_proposal_items"."total_amount" = "crm_proposal_items"."gross_amount" - "crm_proposal_items"."discount_amount"

crm_proposal_items_discount_chk.name: crm_proposal_items_discount_chk
crm_proposal_items_discount_chk.value: "crm_proposal_items"."discount_input" >= 0 AND (("crm_proposal_items"."discount_type" = 'AMOUNT' AND "crm_proposal_items"."discount_amount" = "crm_proposal_items"."discount_input") OR ("crm_proposal_items"."discount_type" = 'PERCENT' AND "crm_proposal_items"."discount_input" <= 100 AND "crm_proposal_items"."discount_amount" = round("crm_proposal_items"."gross_amount" * "crm_proposal_items"."discount_input" / 100, 2)))

crm_proposals_issue_chk.name: crm_proposals_issue_chk
crm_proposals_issue_chk.value: ("crm_proposals"."status" = 'DRAFT' AND "crm_proposals"."issued_snapshot" IS NULL AND "crm_proposals"."issued_hash" IS NULL AND "crm_proposals"."sent_at" IS NULL) OR ("crm_proposals"."status" <> 'DRAFT' AND "crm_proposals"."issued_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "crm_proposals"."issued_hash" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("crm_proposals"."issued_snapshot") = 'object' AND "crm_proposals"."issued_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "crm_proposals"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

crm_proposals_dates_chk.name: crm_proposals_dates_chk
crm_proposals_dates_chk.value: ("crm_proposals"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("crm_proposals"."status" IN ('ACCEPTED','CONVERTED')) AND ("crm_proposals"."declined_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("crm_proposals"."status" = 'DECLINED') AND ("crm_proposals"."converted_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("crm_proposals"."status" = 'CONVERTED')

customers_tax_id_shape_chk.name: customers_tax_id_shape_chk
customers_tax_id_shape_chk.value: "customers"."tax_id" IS NULL OR ("customers"."kind" = 'PF' AND "customers"."tax_id" ~ '^[0-9]{11}$') OR ("customers"."kind" = 'PJ' AND "customers"."tax_id" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$')

email_messages_content_chk.name: email_messages_content_chk
email_messages_content_chk.value: ("email_messages"."invitation_id" IS NULL AND "email_messages"."text_body" IS NOT NULL AND "email_messages"."html_body" IS NOT NULL AND "email_messages"."encrypted_payload" IS NULL) OR ("email_messages"."invitation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_messages"."text_body" IS NULL AND "email_messages"."html_body" IS NULL AND (("email_messages"."encrypted_payload" IS NOT NULL AND "email_messages"."encryption_key_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "email_messages"."send_status" IN ('ACCEPTED','FAILED','UNKNOWN','CANCELED')))

email_messages_accepted_chk.name: email_messages_accepted_chk
email_messages_accepted_chk.value: "email_messages"."send_status" <> 'ACCEPTED' OR ("email_messages"."provider_email_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_messages"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

receivable_movements_kind_chk.name: receivable_movements_kind_chk
receivable_movements_kind_chk.value: ("receivable_movements"."kind" = 'RECEIPT' AND "receivable_movements"."reverses_movement_id" IS NULL AND "receivable_movements"."payment_method" IS NOT NULL AND "receivable_movements"."payment_method" IN ('PIX', 'CASH', 'CREDIT_CARD', 'DEBIT_CARD', 'BOLETO', 'TRANSFER', 'OTHER')) OR ("receivable_movements"."kind" = 'REVERSAL' AND "receivable_movements"."reverses_movement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receivable_movements"."payment_method" IS NULL)

sale_installments_payment_date_chk.name: sale_installments_payment_date_chk
sale_installments_payment_date_chk.value: ("sale_installments"."due_on" IS NOT NULL AND "sale_installments"."initial_received_on" IS NULL) OR ("sale_installments"."due_on" IS NULL AND "sale_installments"."initial_received_on" IS NOT NULL)

sale_items_amounts_chk.name: sale_items_amounts_chk
sale_items_amounts_chk.value: "sale_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "sale_items"."unit_price" >= 0 AND "sale_items"."gross_amount" = round("sale_items"."quantity" * "sale_items"."unit_price", 2) AND "sale_items"."discount_amount" >= 0 AND "sale_items"."discount_amount" <= "sale_items"."gross_amount" AND "sale_items"."total_amount" = "sale_items"."gross_amount" - "sale_items"."discount_amount"

sale_status_history_transition_chk.name: sale_status_history_transition_chk
sale_status_history_transition_chk.value: "sale_status_history"."from_status" IS DISTINCT FROM "sale_status_history"."to_status" AND ("sale_status_history"."from_status" IS NOT NULL OR "sale_status_history"."to_status" = 'DRAFT')

sale_status_history_reason_chk.name: sale_status_history_reason_chk
sale_status_history_reason_chk.value: ("sale_status_history"."to_status" <> 'CANCELED' OR ("sale_status_history"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("sale_status_history"."reason")) > 0)) AND ("sale_status_history"."reason" IS NULL OR length(btrim("sale_status_history"."reason")) > 0)

sales_customer_tax_id_snapshot_chk.name: sales_customer_tax_id_snapshot_chk
sales_customer_tax_id_snapshot_chk.value: "sales"."customer_tax_id_snapshot" IS NULL OR ("sales"."customer_kind_snapshot" = 'PF' AND "sales"."customer_tax_id_snapshot" ~ '^[0-9]{11}$') OR ("sales"."customer_kind_snapshot" = 'PJ' AND "sales"."customer_tax_id_snapshot" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{12}[0-9]{2}$')

sales_confirmed_chk.name: sales_confirmed_chk
sales_confirmed_chk.value: "sales"."status" <> 'CONFIRMED' OR ("sales"."sold_on" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."total_amount" > 0)

stored_files_bytes_chk.name: stored_files_bytes_chk
stored_files_bytes_chk.value: "stored_files"."expected_bytes" > 0 AND "stored_files"."expected_bytes" <= 26214400 AND ("stored_files"."size_bytes" IS NULL OR ("stored_files"."size_bytes" > 0 AND "stored_files"."size_bytes" <= 26214400))

stored_files_ready_chk.name: stored_files_ready_chk
stored_files_ready_chk.value: "stored_files"."status" <> 'READY' OR ("stored_files"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_files"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_files"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stored_files"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "stored_files"."object_deleted_at" IS NULL)

user_invitations_accepted_chk.name: user_invitations_accepted_chk
user_invitations_accepted_chk.value: "user_invitations"."status"<>'ACCEPTED' OR ("user_invitations"."accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

whatsapp_connections_owner_chk.name: whatsapp_connections_owner_chk
whatsapp_connections_owner_chk.value: ("whatsapp_connections"."ownership" = 'PLATFORM' AND "whatsapp_connections"."company_id" IS NULL) OR ("whatsapp_connections"."ownership" = 'COMPANY' AND "whatsapp_connections"."company_id" IS NOT NULL)

whatsapp_link_challenges_mode_chk.name: whatsapp_link_challenges_mode_chk
whatsapp_link_challenges_mode_chk.value: ("whatsapp_link_challenges"."mode" = 'NEW_NUMBER' AND "whatsapp_link_challenges"."expected_link_id" IS NULL) OR ("whatsapp_link_challenges"."mode" = 'EXISTING_NUMBER' AND "whatsapp_link_challenges"."expected_link_id" IS NOT NULL)

whatsapp_requests_selected_chk.name: whatsapp_requests_selected_chk
whatsapp_requests_selected_chk.value: "whatsapp_requests"."status" NOT IN ('AWAITING_REPLY', 'READY', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED') OR "whatsapp_requests"."company_link_id" IS NOT NULL
